sources.title: Needle 2 - The 14 MB Agentic LLM for Tiny Devices | Cactus
sources.snippet: An open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. Needle 2 runs as a 14 MB binary in 28 MB of session RAM.
